verdict.rationale: AI contract parsing feeding procurement request forms is a fair question for a business spend and payments product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents AI document parsing, contract ingestion, or procurement request forms. The documented card spend controls (MCC and currency rules) and dispute file uploads are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.
